description: This file implements console logging configuration and behavior, including log level/style normalization, log routing, console message suppression, and capturing console output for logging purposes.

methods.name: setConsoleConfigLoaderForTests
methods.description: Sets a custom loader for console configuration, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: normalizeConsoleLevel
methods.description: Normalizes the console log level based on verbosity, environment variables, and input.

methods.name: normalizeConsoleStyle
methods.description: Normalizes the console style (pretty, compact, json) based on input and TTY status.

methods.name: resolveConsoleSettings
methods.description: Resolves the current console logging settings, considering environment, config, and overrides.

methods.name: consoleSettingsChanged
methods.description: Checks if two console settings objects differ.

methods.name: getConsoleSettings
methods.description: Returns the current console logger settings, using cache if valid.

methods.name: getResolvedConsoleSettings
methods.description: Alias for getConsoleSettings, returns the current console logger settings.

methods.name: routeLogsToStderr
methods.description: Routes all console logs to stderr instead of stdout.

methods.name: setConsoleSubsystemFilter
methods.description: Sets filters for console subsystems to control logging visibility.

methods.name: setConsoleTimestampPrefix
methods.description: Enables or disables timestamp prefixing in console logs.

methods.name: shouldLogSubsystemToConsole
methods.description: Determines if a given subsystem should be logged to console based on filters.

methods.name: shouldSuppressConsoleMessage
methods.description: Checks if a console message should be suppressed based on prefixes and verbose mode.

methods.name: isEpipeError
methods.description: Checks if an error is an EPIPE or EIO error, typically for stream errors.

methods.name: formatConsoleTimestamp
methods.description: Formats the current timestamp according to the specified console style.

methods.name: hasTimestampPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a timestamp prefix.

methods.name: enableConsoleCapture
methods.description: Overrides console.* methods to route output through logging and capture all console calls into log files, while still emitting to original streams.
